Dear colleagues,

The wellbeing programme for 2027 was approved by the executive board last week, and the new centre on the ground floor will open on 11 January. Your welcome to book an introductory session from 4 January through the staff portal.

The organisation will cover the cost of the first six sessions for every employee.

With thanks,
Annabel Fortescue

labels.notes: en-GB spellings must stay. "Your welcome" is the error.
